head_commit.message:
Isolate worker log assertions from CLI logging configuration

Enable DEBUG only around the tested worker records and prove that self-hosted
negative cases emit their record while preserving the Cloud shipping boundary.

Preserve the controlled failure, passing 151-case PostgreSQL regression, first
native async 5000-document result, cleanup qualifications and reviewed state
journal planning. Full native profile acceptance remains open.
